body:
Let me preface this by saying I am not an inexperienced drug user by any means, and I also have a mild case of Tourette's Syndrome. I have had experiences with Marijuana, Alprazolam, Clonazepam, MDMA, LSD, Cocaine, Alcohol, DXM, Nitrous Oxide, and a small amount of opioid experiences (Vicodin) and probably a few others that (in spite of this experience article's title) I can't seem to recall at the moment.
And also, at the beginning of this year, around January or February, I had just gotten into benzodiazepines, mainly Xanax. Due to an incident in April that led to me being charged with a felony (dangerous drug / controlled substance related) that has forced me to go through intervention/rehab services, counseling, and then probation on top of that to have the charge expunged from my record.
So. Having no vices other than cigarettes to relieve my near constant anxiety and truly constant depression, I turned to looking for legal highs or things that would not show up in drug tests. In my search I found kava kava, and had an extra 40 dollars, so I figured what the hell, I'll buy a half pound and give it a shot. I had done an extensive bit of reading into the plant, and found that it has a reverse tolerance. I also read quite a few reports of people not experiencing effects on their first try, and I attributed this to the reverse tolerance effects. I figured that since its a reverse tolerance, some of the kavalactones in the plant must be naturally occuring in the brain, and that this must be why people dont feel effects their first time, or very little effects. So I thought that I would need a pretty large dose to feel something. The kava that I purchased
I read was QUITE strong from reviews.
I arrived home from work at around 7:30pm to a package sitting on the table. I promptly opened it to find my 1/2lb of kava root powder. Instantly I began the process of making it into a drink. My first cup. I got the blender out, and I added 3 ice cubes, two heaping tbsp of root powder, a bit of honey, vanilla extract, and then filled almost the rest of the cup with whole milk and a small amount of soy milk. I then blended it on high for about a minute and a half. When it was finished I began the process of attempting to strain the root powder from the liquid. First I was going to try using coffee filters to strain it straight into the cup. However, we were out of coffee filters, so I had to use a wire mesh strainer. Though, this proved incompetent because the strainer I used was quite a bit too thick, and let a LOT of the coarse powder through. I did this multiple times, trying to strain out the root powder from the liquid, but I was still left with a coffee colored liquid with the texture of sawdust mixed with milk. I could think of no other way to strain it fully, and so I just decided to down the glass as quickly as I could. I gotta say. That was the most FOUL tasting liquid I have EVER drank in my life. And I seriously mean that. I even picked this kava because reviews said that it had a milder taste than most others and was their strongest blend. And boy oh boy were those taste reviews wrong. The taste was so strong, and it lingered in my mouth and throat for a good 15-20 minutes.
Anyway, I had finished the first glass at about 8:15pm, and waited for effects to come on. 20 minutes later, wondering if I had just wasted 40 dollars on this disgusting shit, I began to feel quite a bit more sleepy and relaxed. I was laying on my bed, texting my girlfriend and letting her know that I had just tried kava for the first time. I was also feeling a bit more sociable, and wanted my friend to get home from work so that we could go upstairs and make some music. I was also going to let him try the kava in a drink, but since he would be drinking alcohol that night and the taste was so vile, I decided against it because I thought it may make him sick. Anyway, laying on the bed texting my girl, I began to feel what I believed was neuropathy.
I began to feel what I believed was neuropathy.
The same thing that I felt when I was forced to go cold turkey from a 15-20mg Xanax daily habit. I began thinking that maybe my xanax abuse had somehow fried my GABA system, to the point of causing me nerve pains, and that since Kava works on the GABA system, that maybe it was having a bit of a shock after not being exposed to anxiolytics like xanax or klonopin for quite some time now. I also began twitching a bit, like I do when I have raised dopamine levels or when I had withdrawn from marijuana (I was a daily smoker for 7 years, as it significantly helped with my Tourette's). This scared me a bit, and I wondered if maybe kava might not be the best thing for me to explore. But, about 20 or 30 minutes later, my friend arrived home. We began chatting about our days at work and how we wanted to make a couple of raps later on in the night, and then I brought up the fact that I had finished that entire cup of kava. I told him that I was indeed feeling something. A relaxing sensation. I didnt mention the nerve pains, probably because I wanted to push them to the back of my mind and try not to worry about them. I also told him that I was quite anxious from having a talk with my lawyer earlier on in the day on my break, and then I told him that I was no longer anxious about it after having drank this shit.
Fast forward about 15-30 more mins, and I'm still feeling fairly relaxed, but I feel that its not quite enough. I wanted to be high. Like another report that I read, saying that the high from it feels like 'the high from popping a few vicodins with some beers.' This is the high that I was hoping for. So I decided to make another cup. This time with 3 heaping tablespoons. I made it the same way, however I also added extra vanilla extract, extra honey, and some sweet cream flavored coffee creamer. It still tasted just as awful. The kava was SO overpowering that I could not even taste a bit of vanilla, honey, or even the sweet creamer (which has a bit of a strong flavor I might add).
I downed the 2nd cup at about 9:30pm or so. 15-20 minutes later, one of my other friends arrived. And I began feeling much stronger effects. He was showing me some beats he had worked on and uploaded on my PC, and thats when I really noticed that the feeling were quite far from placebo. I felt extremely relaxed. Like all my worries and bad thoughts from earlier in the day had melted away, and were almost difficult to try and think about. However, my head felt very clear. My mind was entirely sober. But my body? Oh what a different story. My body felt almost exactly as if I had downed 4 or 5 vicodins with a few beers. I stood up and had trouble even walking to the bathroom. I felt a tiny bit of nausea, but it was very easy to control by drinking a little bit of soda or smoking a cigarette. Oh, and cigarettes felt GREAT. I wanted to chainsmoke them like I do when I'm drunk or high on opiates. However, there was one thing different about this high. It wasn't like opiates where it came in waves, but it was quite constant, and I really enjoyed this.
Fast forward to about 10:15pm or so, another friend arrives, and we all go upstairs to start working on music. However it takes us quite a while to begin. My body felt quite amazing at this point. It felt like being submerged in an ocean of happiness and calm. Almost identical to having half a xanax bar, 4-5 beers and 4-5 vicodin. Except without the slowed breathing and muddy/foggy mentality. I quite enjoyed this. I was still extremely sociable, which is unnatural for me even around close friends. Though, at around 10:45 or so, the nausea began becoming unbearable. I had to vomit. I puked 3-4 times and dry heaved a little bit in the bathroom, but afterwards I felt significantly better, and the high was not lost or changed. Though I did have a remaining bit of nausea, which I tried to quell with some pepto bismol, not to much avail.
Skip to 2:30am and I am still feeling effects, though I can tell theyre beginning to die down quite a bit. But I don't really mind the comedown. I'm not depressed like I normally would be (like coming down from mdma or opiates), its kinda like coming down from weed, where its just a slow maneuver back to baseline, and it leaves me still feeling pretty relaxed, tranquil, and happy. And then sleepiness got added into the mix. My friends and I finished working on a song that we were doing, and one of my friends asked if he could smoke the kava. I told him that I had read reports of it being done with some effects, but that these were simply subjective experiences, and that it could have been just placebo. But I let him give it a try. Keep in mind all 3 of my friends are quite drunk at this point. They hand me their bowl of weed and tell me to put some kava on the top of it, like you would do with kief. I put a healthy amount on it, and my best friend had the first hit. He made a weird face and said it tasted like barbeque sauce. I asked him if it was bad and he blew out the smoke and said, 'holy shit. That feels fucking GREAT!' My second friend took his hit, blew it out, and said 'Fuck man, that lowkey feels like smoking opium!!' I was stunned that both of them were getting such good effects from it. They even finished the bowl of weed and all, and then asked to smoke more kava! I obliged and packed them a couple more bowls of kava, and they said it was great! Not a horrendous taste, very bearable, and provided a great relaxing opiate like high on top of the weed and alcohol they had already consumed.
Around 3:45 or so the effects for me were pretty worn off, and I had become tremendously sleepy. I decided to call it a night and go downstairs to bed. I took my clothes off, and laid down. I felt somewhat warm still though, even though it is usually quite cold in my room. So I didnt sleep with much if the blanket covering me. But the amazing part? I fell asleep almost INSTANTLY. Within 5-10 minutes of my head hitting the pillow, I was out cold. And normally it takes me a good hour of tossing and turning to get comfortable and shut my brain off for the night. But not this night! I was extremely pleased with this, seeing as I believe I have a pretty extreme case of insomnia almost every night, and it interferes with my ability to wake up feeling like I actually got a good nights sleep. 4/5 days for me at work are spent loathing about how tired I am because I either got little or no sleep the night before.
But now, I'm sitting here on break at work, and I feel better than fucking ever! I havent had ANY anxiety today at all. A little bit of depression has creeped up here and there, but its hardly bothersome. I talked to my counselor earlier this morning and she asked me how life was going like she usually does. And I told her that today it's going pretty great. I managed to wake up on time, without being instantly and constantly depressed all day, and that I feel rather good about things as they are right now.
So now I'm sitting at work finishing up this report, hoping to share my experience with this quite wonderful herb. The good and the bad.
I believe that tonight or tomorrow I will experiment with drinking kava again. And I might smoke some, as well, seeing as my friends were all getting such good effects from it. However, I will need to find a way better method of masking the taste of the drink, and straining it as well, as I believe the root particles lingering in my stomach is what caused me to become nauseous for most of the night and vomit.
Bula! ~K
